q: State the hardness of pure copper.
How many times harder is bronze with 10% tin?
Explain why adding tin makes copper harder.
Tin atoms are a different size: they distort the layers, so the layers cannot slide over each other easily.
Suggest why bells are made from bronze with about 20% tin, not 30%.
About 20% gives hardness and a clear ring; much more tin makes the alloy brittle, so it could crack. (The graph also levels off.)
